interactive.label: ✓ Welcome
interactive.tooltip: A quick guided setup for a new ChiSurf installation.

interactive.label: Settings
interactive.tooltip: Review your user settings files; open the editor when needed.

interactive.label: ✓ Fix / Initialize
interactive.tooltip: Create missing settings files or restore packaged defaults.

interactive.label: ✓ Experiments
interactive.tooltip: Update experiment/model configuration so new models appear.

interactive.label: ✓ Dependencies
interactive.tooltip: Check optional Python packages used by specific features.

interactive.label: Detector setup
interactive.tooltip: Configure PIE / channel windows for TTTR workflows.

interactive.label: FCS channels
interactive.tooltip: Define which channels/pairs to correlate for FCS workflows.

interactive.label: ✓ Finish
interactive.tooltip: You are ready to start working.

interactive.label: Back
interactive.tooltip: Go to the previous step. Not available on the first step.

interactive.label: Next
interactive.tooltip: Go to the following step. Every step can be skipped; nothing has to be completed first.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the steps of the wizard.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through the wizard step by step.

interactive.label: Open settings folder
interactive.tooltip: Open the user settings folder (~/.chisurf) in your file manager.

interactive.label: Refresh
interactive.tooltip: Re-check the settings files.

interactive.label: Open settings editor
interactive.tooltip: Open the ChiSurf settings editor to adjust paths and options.

interactive.label: Create missing files
interactive.tooltip: Only writes settings files that do not exist yet.

interactive.label: Restore defaults (overwrite)
interactive.tooltip: Replace current user settings files with packaged defaults. Asks first.

interactive.label: Update experiments
interactive.tooltip: Re-sync experiment_configs.yaml from the packaged default so new fitting models (e.g. the AutoForm PDA models) show up. Requires a restart.

interactive.label: Refresh
interactive.tooltip: Re-check the optional dependencies.

interactive.label: setup_choice
interactive.tooltip: Choose a saved detector setup; its detectors, PIE windows, reading routine, LUTs and optical setup replace the working definition.

interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Ask for a name and store the working definition as a saved setup.

interactive.label: Rename
interactive.tooltip: Give the selected saved setup another name.

interactive.label: Delete
interactive.tooltip: Delete the selected saved setup after asking.

interactive.label: Public
interactive.tooltip: When checked, the setup is visible to all users in the MMFDB; it takes effect with Save. Only the owner of a saved setup can change this.

interactive.label: calibration_choice
interactive.tooltip: Pick a stored calibration snapshot of the selected setup: its G factor, l1 and l2 are applied to the detectors. Latest leaves the factors as they are.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the setups, the six tabs, units of micro-time ranges and LUTs.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through choosing, editing and saving a setup.

interactive.label: Setups
interactive.tooltip: Manage named setup definitions and calibration revisions.

interactive.label: Refresh setups
interactive.tooltip: Load available saved detector setups from MMFDB or the selected JSON file.

interactive.label: channel_setup
interactive.tooltip: Select a named instrument setup and restore all detector, timing and optical parameters.

interactive.label: Setup name
interactive.tooltip: Name used when saving or renaming the detector setup.

interactive.label: Public setup
interactive.tooltip: Publish the saved setup for other users through the MMFDB setup store.

interactive.label: Save setup
interactive.tooltip: Persist all channels, windows, corrections and optical configuration.

interactive.label: Rename setup
interactive.tooltip: Rename the selected saved setup to the entered name.

interactive.label: Delete setup
interactive.tooltip: Request deletion of the selected saved setup.

interactive.label: Load setups file
interactive.tooltip: Choose a detector-setup JSON library.

interactive.label: Export setups file
interactive.tooltip: Save all loaded named setups as a JSON library.

interactive.label: calibration
interactive.tooltip: Load stored G-factor and polarization-mixing values from this calibration revision.

interactive.label: Refresh calibration history
interactive.tooltip: Query calibration dates for this setup.

interactive.label: TTTR reading
interactive.tooltip: Select format, timing, binning and header/decay calibration.

interactive.label: Detectors
interactive.tooltip: Edit routing channels, microtime gates and polarization factors.

interactive.label: PIE windows
interactive.tooltip: Define excitation gates and detector/window combinations.

interactive.label: TAC corrections
interactive.tooltip: Assign or compute per-routing-channel TAC LUTs and shifts.

interactive.label: Optical setup
interactive.tooltip: Edit and simulate the instrument light path.

interactive.label: Detector setup
interactive.tooltip: Choose the detector setup whose logical channels are paired.

interactive.label: Public
interactive.tooltip: Only the owner may change sharing with other MMFDB users.

interactive.label: Reload
interactive.tooltip: Reload saved detector setups and presets; discard editing drafts.

interactive.label: A
interactive.tooltip: First logical detector/excitation channel.

interactive.label: B
interactive.tooltip: Second channel; identical channels make an autocorrelation.

interactive.label: new_name
interactive.tooltip: Optional unique pair name; otherwise an ACF or cross-channel label is generated.

interactive.label: Add
interactive.tooltip: Add a channel pair with the configured correlator defaults.

interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Validate and persist pairs for this detector setup.

interactive.label: Apply
interactive.tooltip: Save as the active preset and notify a connected correlator when provided.

interactive.label: Delete preset
interactive.tooltip: Delete only the FCS preset; retain its detector definition.

interactive.label: Import JSON
interactive.tooltip: Import and persist a channel preset library from JSON.

interactive.label: Export JSON
interactive.tooltip: Export the full library including this current editing draft.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain logical channels, correlation pairs and per-pair settings.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through selecting a setup, creating pairs and saving.

interactive.label: Close
interactive.tooltip: Close this native editor; exported host state preserves drafts.

interactive.label: Finish
interactive.tooltip: Close the wizard. You can run it again from the Plugin Manager.

interactive.label: Open Help
interactive.tooltip: Browse experiment-specific guides and built-in documentation.

interactive.label: Open Plugin Manager
interactive.tooltip: Manage installed plugins.

interactive.label: tttr_format
interactive.tooltip: Choose the TTTR container type, or auto for header detection.

interactive.label: Macro-time tick (ns)
interactive.tooltip: Seconds per macro-time tick expressed in nanoseconds.

interactive.label: Micro-time tick (ps)
interactive.tooltip: Seconds per microtime channel expressed in picoseconds.

interactive.label: Override header timing
interactive.tooltip: Apply the entered macro/microtime calibration to newly read measurements; otherwise use their header.

interactive.label: Microtime binning
interactive.tooltip: Number of original TAC channels per analysis bin.

interactive.label: Read TTTR header and decay
interactive.tooltip: Read a measurement or BH SET calibration, including per-channel decay histograms.

interactive.label: Show microtime preview
interactive.tooltip: Display routing-channel decays and detector/PIE windows.

interactive.label: Polarization resolved
interactive.tooltip: Treat paired routing streams as VV/VH polarization channels.

interactive.label: New detector name
interactive.tooltip: Name of the detector to add.

interactive.label: Add detector
interactive.tooltip: Create a named detector with editable routing, gates and calibration factors.

interactive.label: green
interactive.tooltip: Edit routing, microtime gates and polarization calibration for green.

interactive.label: Detector name
interactive.tooltip: New name for this detector; use Rename to retain all calibrations.

interactive.label: Rename detector
interactive.tooltip: Rename this detector while preserving channels, gates and calibration metadata.

interactive.label: Routing channels
interactive.tooltip: Comma-separated TTTR routing channels.

interactive.label: Microtime ranges
interactive.tooltip: One or more start:end TAC gates, separated by commas.

interactive.label: G factor
interactive.tooltip: Polarization sensitivity correction for this detector.

interactive.label: l1 factor
interactive.tooltip: Polarization mixing correction l1.

interactive.label: l2 factor
interactive.tooltip: Polarization mixing correction l2.

interactive.label: G-factor channel range
interactive.tooltip: TAC start:end tail range used to calculate the VV/VH G factor.

interactive.label: Calculate G from preview
interactive.tooltip: Calculate a tail-matched G factor from the loaded parallel/perpendicular decays.

interactive.label: Archive G calibration
interactive.tooltip: Register the calculated reference decay and calibration provenance in MMFDB.

interactive.label: Read G calibration measurement
interactive.tooltip: Load parallel/perpendicular decays for G-factor calculation.

interactive.label: Remove detector
interactive.tooltip: Remove this detector from the working definition.

interactive.label: red
interactive.tooltip: Edit routing, microtime gates and polarization calibration for red.

interactive.label: yellow
interactive.tooltip: Edit routing, microtime gates and polarization calibration for yellow.

interactive.label: New PIE window name
interactive.tooltip: Name of the excitation-period microtime window.

interactive.label: Start TAC channel
interactive.tooltip: First TAC bin in the new PIE window.

interactive.label: End TAC channel
interactive.tooltip: Exclusive upper TAC bin of the new PIE window.

interactive.label: Add PIE window
interactive.tooltip: Add a named microtime window and publish the window/detector channel combinations.

interactive.label: Window name
interactive.tooltip: New name for this excitation window; use Rename to commit it.

interactive.label: Rename window
interactive.tooltip: Rename this PIE window and its detector/window combinations.

interactive.label: Start
interactive.tooltip: First TAC bin of PIE window prompt.

interactive.label: End
interactive.tooltip: Exclusive upper TAC bin of PIE window prompt.

interactive.label: Remove window
interactive.tooltip: Remove this PIE excitation window.

interactive.label: Start
interactive.tooltip: First TAC bin of PIE window delayed.

interactive.label: End
interactive.tooltip: Exclusive upper TAC bin of PIE window delayed.

interactive.label: Apply TAC LUTs and shifts
interactive.tooltip: Apply assigned TAC linearization and per-channel shifts to every analysis read using this setup.

interactive.label: Routing channel
interactive.tooltip: Routing channel whose LUT and microtime shift are edited.

interactive.label: Microtime shift (bins)
interactive.tooltip: Shift applied after linearization to align the selected detector decay.

interactive.label: Export channel LUT
interactive.tooltip: Save this channel correction as a reusable TAC table.

interactive.label: Assign LUT file
interactive.tooltip: Load a TAC linearization table for the selected routing channel.

interactive.label: Linear region start
interactive.tooltip: First channel of the uniform-illumination linear calibration region.

interactive.label: Linear region stop
interactive.tooltip: Last channel of the linear calibration region; choose Auto to infer it.

interactive.label: Compute TAC LUT
interactive.tooltip: Build a TAC table from the selected channel histogram and the entered linear region.

interactive.label: Auto-detect TAC LUT
interactive.tooltip: Infer a populated linear region and calculate its TAC correction.

interactive.label: Remove channel LUT
interactive.tooltip: Remove the correction table from this channel.

interactive.label: Open advanced graph editor
interactive.tooltip: Edit arbitrary components and optical connections; apply the full graph back to this setup.

interactive.label: Refresh optical catalogue
interactive.tooltip: Load available dye, transmission and detector spectra from MMFDB.

interactive.label: Load optical preset
interactive.tooltip: Load an easy-mode configuration or a light-path graph.

interactive.label: Save optical preset
interactive.tooltip: Save the complete optical configuration including cached simulation results.

interactive.label: optical_template
interactive.tooltip: Load a packaged instrument light-path template.

interactive.label: optical_lasers
interactive.tooltip: Comma-separated excitation lines in nanometers with relative powers, for example 488:1.0, 640:1.0.

interactive.label: optical_kappa2
interactive.tooltip: Parameter used in the Förster-radius calculation for the selected fluorophores.

interactive.label: optical_n
interactive.tooltip: Parameter used in the Förster-radius calculation for the selected fluorophores.

interactive.label: Excitation dichroic
interactive.tooltip: Select the measured spectrum used for excitation dichroic.

interactive.label: Add fluorophore
interactive.tooltip: Select the measured spectrum used for add fluorophore.

interactive.label: Add emission splitter
interactive.tooltip: Add a measured dichroic or polarizer in the detection path.

interactive.label: new_optical_detector
interactive.tooltip: Name of the optical detector channel to add.

interactive.label: Add optical detector
interactive.tooltip: Add a detector channel with its bandpass and quantum-efficiency spectrum.

interactive.label: Bandpass
interactive.tooltip: Select the measured spectrum used for bandpass.

interactive.label: Quantum efficiency
interactive.tooltip: Select the measured spectrum used for quantum efficiency.

interactive.label: Remove optical detector
interactive.tooltip: Remove this detector from the simulated light path.

interactive.label: Simulate optical setup
interactive.tooltip: Calculate Förster radii and excitation/emission/detection crosstalk using the original optical backend.

interactive.label: ✓ Detector setup
interactive.tooltip: Configure PIE / channel windows for TTTR workflows.

interactive.label: ✓ FCS channels
interactive.tooltip: Define which channels/pairs to correlate for FCS workflows.

interactive.label: green×red
interactive.tooltip: Select this pair to edit its channels and correlator overrides.

interactive.label: green_ACF
interactive.tooltip: Select this pair to edit its channels and correlator overrides.

interactive.label: pair_name
interactive.tooltip: Unique name used by the correlation tools and database.

interactive.label: Channel A
interactive.tooltip: Choose an available logical channel from the detector setup.

interactive.label: Channel B
interactive.tooltip: Choose an available logical channel from the detector setup.

interactive.label: n_bins
interactive.tooltip: Positive whole-number override; leave blank to inherit global settings.

interactive.label: n_casc
interactive.tooltip: Positive whole-number override; leave blank to inherit global settings.

interactive.label: Fine
interactive.tooltip: Override the fine correlation grid or inherit its default.

interactive.label: Remove this pair
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected pair from this editing draft.
Close this window (Escape).

interactive.label: Restore defaults
interactive.tooltip: Replace your current user settings files with the packaged defaults.

interactive.label: Keep my settings
interactive.tooltip: Close this question; nothing changes.
